lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu4Pr4Sn8 (EuPrSn2) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: each Eu and Pr center has eight Sn neighbors, while each Sn center has four Eu and four Pr neighbors, all at 3.259 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Sn–Sn polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, while Eu–Pr polyhedra share corners and faces.
